name: Unholy Hunger

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

disable: DC 19 Cooking-lore check to neutralize the haunted soup with the addition of a few select spices from nearby shelves, or DC 25 Religion check to exorcise the haunt
reset: The haunt resets 1 round after the lid is replaced on the cooking pot.

items.name: Worse Than It Smells
items.text:
Trigger A non-nindoru creature takes the lid off the cooking pot

---
Effect All creatures within 15 feet of the pot must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save save or become Sickened 2. The triggering creature instead must attempt a DC 24 Will save save to resist the compulsion to dip their face into the stew and swallow a mouthful of the stuff (this effect has the emotion and mental traits). On a failure, the triggering creature takes 5d6 poison damage (DC 24 basic Fortitude save save).

text: An unspeakable miasma of foul-smelling vapor with shrieking faces barely visible in the steam bubbles up from the soup.
